title: Grateful Dead Live at Philadelphia Civic Arena on 1974-08-05
lineage: Cassette (Nakamkichi Dragon) > DAT (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) > Avid MBox Pro > Pro Tools 12 > WAV (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: Glorious soundboard captures a partial 1974 show that’s praised for its incredible Dead DNA and overall performance.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the recording, noting the pristine soundboard capture by Lavatla, Eaton, and Miller. The performance itself is described as “incredible,” with the whole of 1974 highlighted as a high point in the Dead’s catalog. No specific flaws are mentioned, making this a highly recommended listen.

ai_rating.rationale: One solid 5‑star rating and another enthusiastic but unrated review both emphasize an excellent soundboard and a great show, yielding a high combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Glorious, clear soundboard recording; no noted issues with clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the entire show as incredible and representative of a stellar 1974 period for the Dead.
